statements: Support keeps seeing customers charged twice for one order when the payment gateway is slow. Someone proposes lowering the retry count in src/payments.mjs.
Stop the double charges. A customer must never pay twice for one order, however the charge is reached and whatever the gateway does.
Keep chargeOrder(order, deps) with its current arguments and result shape. The gateway's contract is in the README.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Stop customers being charged twice for one order, as the numbered statements describe. The README describes the gateway. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
